annotation.title_clean: 「ガバメント AI 源内」商標およびブランドガイドライン
annotation.title_en: Government AI "Gennai" Trademark and Brand Guidelines
annotation.summary_en: The trademark and brand guidelines issued by Japan's Digital Agency for "Government AI Gennai", the government's generative AI environment, which is partly open source. They keep the copyright licence (MIT) separate from brand use. Permitted uses of the name and logo depend on the type of user, how much the code is modified and how it is provided. The aim is to prevent false implied government endorsement.
key_provisions_or_claims: The code licence (MIT) does not grant rights to use the Gennai name or logo; brand use is governed separately by these guidelines.
Users may refer to their factual relationship with Gennai freely, provided they do not imply endorsement or certification by the Digital Agency or the Japanese government.
Derivative works (forks) must carry their own names and show their link to Gennai only through statements of derivation.
Permission tables set out allowed display forms for five user categories: ministries, local governments, corporations, individuals or voluntary groups, and third parties.

Mandatory standard notices for derivative works, embedded components and anti-misidentification; a single Digital Agency contact point handles inquiries and reports of misuse, with legal action possible.
